name: Room turn priority list
summary: Each morning the housekeeping supervisor gets one worklist of the rooms to turn, in the property's own priority order, with rooms awaiting inspection marked and every conflict in status written as a question. It inspects nothing and assigns nobody.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of hospitality operations, and its own rules for prepared work: the property's lists, notes and priority rules as the only authority, set column headings with a stop on a mismatch, every conflict written as a question for a named role, and a person who verifies, decides and assigns.
